PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000" -TimeoutSec 4 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Host "LEN: $\($r.Content.Length\)" } catch { Write-Host "SERVER NOT RESPONDING: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000" -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "HOME STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $h = $r.Content; Write-Host "HOME LEN: $\($h.Length\)" } catch { Write-Host "HOME NOT RESPONDING: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(foreach \($p in @\("/","/about","/services","/clients","/gallery","/quote","/contact"\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$p" -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing; "$p -> $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "$p -> ERR $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell($base="http://localhost:3000"; $routes=@\("/", "/about", "/services", "/clients", "/gallery", "/quote", "/contact", "/sitemap.xml", "/robots.txt"\); foreach \($r in $routes\) { try { $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri \($base+$r\) -TimeoutSec 8 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host \("$r -> " + $resp.StatusCode + " \(" + $resp.Content.Length + " bytes\)"\) } catch { Write-Host \("$r -> " + $_.Exception.Message\) } })
